label: breitkopf
adjudicator: the session that built the crop tool -- ONE adjudicator, no inter-rater figure
question: The RED brackets mark one notehead and the BLUE brackets mark another. Do these two noteheads share ONE printed stem -- are they two members of the same chord?
how: wide staff strip first (100 px per staff space, NEAREST, ticks in the margin, corner brackets clear of the ink); a zoom at 3.0 spaces of context taken as a SECOND view where the wide one was ambiguous. Both views kept.
